Delhi Traffic Police has issued a traffic advisory.

Traffic movement is likely to be affected in Central & North Delhi on 24.05.2026 due to the “Janjati Saanskritik Samagam” at Red Fort and multiple Shobha Yatras heading towards the venue.

📍 Restrictions/diversions will be in place on major stretches, including Netaji Subhash Marg, JLN Marg, Lothian Road, GT Karnal Road, Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Marg, Asaf Ali Road, DBG Road, and adjoining areas.

Commuters are advised to:
• Avoid non-essential travel in affected areas
• Plan journeys in advance
• Use alternate routes
• Prefer Delhi Metro & public transport
• Keep sufficient travel time for NDLS, ODRS & ISBT Kashmere Gate

Please follow the directions of Delhi Traffic Police personnel on duty.
